## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Improved CI handling for cancelled jobs, including safe reruns of eligible infrastructure interruptions.
  - Added runtime-cap warnings for checks approaching or exceeding configured limits without changing pass/fail results.
  - Formal-model checks now distribute work according to measured processing costs for more balanced execution.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Sharded test and model-checking results now distinguish completed work from incomplete cancellations, reducing misleading CI outcomes.
  - Increased the formal-model check timeout from 12 to 20 minutes.
  - CI verdicts now fail safely when shard evidence is missing, incomplete, or unreadable.
